summary.text: Lucetta Elmer is a Republican state representative from District 24 who has represented the district since January 9, 2023 and is seeking re-election.
She was elected House Minority Leader on October 1, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Lucetta Elmer was born in McMinnville, Oregon, and earned a B.S. in education from Linfield University.
Her career experience includes serving as managing partner and business owner of a boutique hotel and a coffee shop.
On October 1, 2025, Elmer was elected State House Minority Leader, replacing Christine Drazan.
